```java title="Java"

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>First paragraph.</p><p>Second paragraph.</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
